column1: PART  IV(A) – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 05.12.2019

column2: All structures and fixtures above the food-handling areas must be installed to prevent direct and indirect
combustion of food and ingredients by condensation and leakage. All fixtures should be clean and free of
Fire extinguishers shall be provided on site.
Temporary stops and toiletries for employees should be separate from the serving area and not directly
open to the food handling area.
